purpose: Training-only retrieval design decision; not confirmatory test evidence and not an answer-quality experiment.
api_policy: zero Groq or other LLM calls; RetrievalOnlyAnswerer only

sample.sampling: deterministic streaming bottom-hash within dataset-answerability-length/hop strata

partition.design_decisions_use: selection partition; tuning and all-sample results remain descriptive

systems.legacy_primary: Frozen four-view SAR-RAG using hierarchical v1
systems.candidate_primary: Same frozen controls with hierarchical v1 replaced by hierarchical_v2
systems.weight_status: predeclared neutral candidate, not claimed optimal
systems.forced_pairs: all six pairs in each four-view system under the same shared final context/chunk/candidate budgets

secondary_outcomes: offline index vector bytes and indexing time

diagnostics.oracle1: per-question maximum across the four single-view systems
diagnostics.oracle2: per-question maximum across the same singles and all six forced pairs
diagnostics.oracles_are: label-only diagnostics, unavailable at inference and not generalization estimates
diagnostics.tie_policy: retain the full set of maximizers; never declaration-order argmax
diagnostics.gate_instrumentation: reached, would-reject, binding and downstream-output effect

inference.multiplicity: Holm correction separately by metric and scope for all conditions, plus transparent four-single-view families
inference.report: mean paired difference, 95% CI, raw p, Holm p, effect size and valid paired n

decision_rules.hierarchy_candidate_retained: On the untouched selection partition, hierarchical_v2 must improve recall over hierarchical v1 and the candidate four-view primary must be no worse than legacy primary by the -0.02 recall margin. Retention additionally requires either >=0.02 candidate-primary recall gain, >=10% context reduction under recall noninferiority, or >=0.02 Oracle@2 gain over the legacy representation set.
decision_rules.routing_claim_retained: On selection, candidate primary must be noninferior to the best constant single view within -0.02 recall and either gain >=0.02 recall or reduce context >=10%. Oracle@2 must exceed the best constant single view by >=0.05 to support a materially useful routing ceiling.
decision_rules.gate_retained_as_claimed_component: Removing the gate must change at least one final retrieval output and its paired effect must not reduce recall or complete evidence beyond -0.02. Merely being reached or binding is insufficient.
decision_rules.pivot_rule: If routing_claim_retained fails, stop presenting representation routing as the central contribution and pivot to the strongest adaptive single-view or budget-matched retrieval method.
